description: zizmor CI record (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record, tap#365) — the stack this plugin's own tests run in, and the one claim per-plugin CI is allowed to make: that zizmor is correct against the dependencies it DECLARES and nothing else. Install set is exactly the depends_on closure (identity_core, git_core, compliance_core, github_core) plus zizmor itself; the consumer flips the self entry to editable so the CHECKOUT under test runs, not the pinned revision. Population is empty: this plugin ships no GRIFT to seed. DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: every other plugin, all credentials, all required_secrets, and any population step that reaches the network — so a fork can run this lane and a nightly cannot flake on a third party (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record-5). Reproduce CI exactly: spawn --from 'git+https://github.com/unified-systems-com/zizmor-tap@97190065bff3a88d4c2a2aa52926660708bf167f#ci' --dev-plugins zizmor

steps.note: zizmor's workflow page mounts github_core's anatomy panel by edge; the panel must exist before zizmor's pages seed. Only the workflow page — the repo-landing bundle stays out.

fips_waivers.reason: zizmor is a static YAML linter for GitHub Actions workflows; the shipped Rust binary links boringssl and aws-lc-rs for its HTTPS client (fetching remote workflow references), which TAP never invokes in the operational request path — the plugin runs zizmor on local files only. No TAP data is encrypted, signed or hashed by these providers. Waived for the plugin's own test stack (zizmor-tap#10 owns the product decision: declare in [fips] or build against system OpenSSL).
